channel.title: dharmatiles changelog
channel.description: New versions of dharmatiles: procedural, printable terrain tiles for tabletop games.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.2.0
item.description: The editor, and tiles named by their files. Select, change, place and draw on the tile in the preview; work saves as you go with one undo history. The tile node no longer takes a name (breaking: remove it; every tile's random layout changes once); rename in the editor. Cliffs in all nine forms, the library read from disk, overhang in two steps (55° target, 55–65° budgeted), 3MF as a Bambu Studio project, and a rewritten site.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.1.0
item.description: The first published version: dharmatiles as a single Rust program. The .dtile tile language, fifteen elements, the printability gate, DungeonBlocks and OpenLOCK bases, a live preview, painted 3MF, and a library of tiles. macOS on Apple silicon through Homebrew.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.9: the move to Rust
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. The program rebuilt in Rust, element by element, and the tile language settled on KDL v2.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.8: the labs
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. Experiments that set the look of today's grass, rocks, meadows, water, bare earth, reeds and cliffs.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.7: walls and floors
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. Brick, cut-stone and drystone fieldstone walls, and floors.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.6: trees
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. Grown trees with bark, clumped crowns and printable leaves; faceted rocks.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.5: composed tiles
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. Rocks and grass together, grass and water on one tile, sampled parameters, a build record in every file.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.4: a library
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. A Python library, grass grown blade by blade, the OpenLOCK base, per-face colours.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.3: grass blades
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. 3D grass blades that stack and arch, printable without supports.

item.title: dharmatiles 0.0.1: the first tile
item.description: Not published; numbered after the fact. A blank DungeonBlocks square with grass pressed in from a heightmap.
